# LibGuides at Royal Roads University

> Comprehensive library and writing support platform providing research guides, academic writing instruction, and student learning resources for Royal Roads University.

LibGuides at Royal Roads University serves as the central hub for the Library & Writing Centre, offering curated research guides, writing tutorials, and academic support resources. The platform leverages Springshare's LibGuides technology to deliver subject-specific guides and integrated writing support across undergraduate and graduate levels.

## Key Topics

- Academic Writing
- Research Guides
- Library Resources
- Writing Support
- Graduate-Level Writing
- Academic Integrity
- Research Skills
- Student Support
- Essay Writing
- Library Profiles
- Subject Guides
- Academic Skills
- Writing Centre
- Resource Discovery
- Learning Strategies

## Getting Started

- [Home - LibGuides at Royal Roads University](https://libguides.royalroads.ca): LibGuides homepage for Royal Roads University library resources and research guides
- [Profiles - LibGuides at Royal Roads University](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/prf.php): Library profiles directory showcasing research guides and library services

## Academic Writing Guides

- [How to write an undergraduate-level essay](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/ugrad_essay): Comprehensive guide to undergraduate essay writing and research guidance
- [Reading, thinking, and writing at a graduate level](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/reading-thinking-writing): Graduate-level guide for critical reading, thinking, and academic writing skills
- [Introduction to academic writing - Types of academic writing](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/typesacademicwriting): Guide to types of academic writing including essays and literature reviews

## Writing Skills & Techniques

- [Editing and revising resources](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/editing_revising): Writing guide covering editing, revision strategies, and self-editing techniques
- [Sentences and style](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/sentences): Writing guide on sentence structure, grammar, and academic style

## Research & Academic Standards

- [Academic integrity](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/academicintegrity): Guide to academic integrity standards and North American academic ethics
- [Identify knowledge (Library & Writing Centre orientation, Stage 3)](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/orientation3): Stage 3 orientation guide for library research and writing skills development

## Student Support

- [Am I the only one who feels like this? - Anxiety about reading](https://libguides.royalroads.ca/read): Student support guide addressing reading anxiety and academic reading strategies
